parts.title: Part 1
parts.instructions: WRITING TASK 1 · You should spend about 20 minutes on this task. Summarise the information by selecting and reporting the main features, and make comparisons where relevant. Write at least 150 words.

questions.q:
1  WRITING TASK 1 · You should spend about 20 minutes on this task.

The bar chart below shows the number of breeding pairs of three seabird species recorded on Kestrel Rock, a small island nature reserve, in 1996, 2006 and 2016. The table shows the breeding success of the same three species in those years, measured as the percentage of nests that produced at least one surviving chick.

Summarise the information by selecting and reporting the main features, and make comparisons where relevant.

BAR CHART — Number of breeding pairs on Kestrel Rock
(vertical axis: breeding pairs, 0 to 14,000, marked every 2,000; three bars per species, one for each year)

Species                 | 1996   | 2006   | 2016
Ash-winged petrel       |  4,200 |  2,600 |  1,500
Speckled guillemot      |  9,800 | 11,400 | 12,100
Northern storm gull     |  3,100 |  3,050 |  5,700
Total (all three)       | 17,100 | 17,050 | 19,300

TABLE — Breeding success (percentage of nests producing at least one surviving chick)

Species                 | 1996 | 2006 | 2016
Ash-winged petrel       | 61%  | 44%  | 29%
Speckled guillemot      | 55%  | 60%  | 63%
Northern storm gull     | 48%  | 47%  | 58%
Reserve average         | 55%  | 50%  | 50%

Write at least 150 words.

parts.title: Part 2
parts.instructions: WRITING TASK 2 · You should spend about 40 minutes on this task. Write about the following topic. Give reasons for your answer and include any relevant examples from your own knowledge or experience. Write at least 250 words.

questions.q:
2  WRITING TASK 2 · You should spend about 40 minutes on this task.

Write about the following topic:

Some people believe that protecting wild animals and their natural habitats should be the responsibility of national governments, which alone can pass laws and fund large reserves. Others argue that lasting protection depends far more on the daily choices of ordinary individuals.

Discuss both these views and give your own opinion.

Give reasons for your answer and include any relevant examples from your own knowledge or experience.

Write at least 250 words.
